summary: Evidence is thin: news found only the 17 Nov US selloff, scanner gave no probabilities, papers gave a 0.02 momentum tilt. History is the main signal. I approve only where history and a second agent agree and no scheduled event sits inside the horizon: USDCHF, the two US indices (oversold bounce), and BTCUSD. USDCAD, EURUSD, GBP and DAX/FTSE are refused because the scanner lists 20 Nov events that make direction two-sided. Next: news and scanner need dated sources for FX, gold, oil and crypto.
